options.name: auth_password
options.description: Set auth password of V3 trap or v3get/v3set, Password is a string of 8 to 16 alpha-numeric characters. Required when I(auth_protocol) is either C(SHA) or C(MD5).

options.name: auth_protocol
options.description: Choose authentication of V3 trap or v3get/v3set.

options.name: community
options.description: Community of v1/v2c or v1get/v1set/v2cget/v2cset. Only the M5 models support this feature.

options.name: host
options.description: Specifies the DNS host name or address for connecting to the remote device over the specified transport.  The value of host is used as the destination address for the transport.

options.name: password
options.description: Specifies the password to use to authenticate the connection to the remote device. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(ANSIBLE_NET_PASSWORD) will be used instead.

options.name: priv_password
options.description: Set privacy password of V3 trap or v3get/v3set, password is a string of 8 to 16 alpha-numeric characters. Required when I(priv_protocol) is either C(DES) or C(AES).

options.name: priv_protocol
options.description: Choose Privacy of V3 trap or v3get/v3set.

options.name: provider
options.description: A dict object containing connection details.

options.name: read_community
options.description: Read Only Community,Community should between 1 and 16 characters. Only the M6 models support this feature.

options.name: read_write_community
options.description: Read And Write Community,Community should between 1 and 16 characters. Only the M6 models support this feature.

options.name: snmp_status
options.description: NMP read/write status of customize, the input parameters are 'v1get', 'v1set', 'v2cget', 'v2cset', 'v3get', 'v3set',separated by commas,such as v1get,v1set,v2cget. Only the M5 models support this feature.

options.name: username
options.description: Configures the username to use to authenticate the connection to the remote device. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(ANSIBLE_NET_USERNAME) will be used instead.

options.name: v3username
options.description: Set user name of V3 trap or v3get/v3set.

options.name: version
options.description: SNMP trap version option, 0 - 'v1', 1 - 'v2c', 2 - 'v3', 3 - 'all', 4 - 'customize'. Only the M5 models support this feature.
